GLoBES.note: Driven with a chord profile subdivided in PATH LENGTH at every PREM crossing, which is what glbSetProfileDataInSection accepts.  The previous radial shell stack made its error oscillate rather than converge -- 512 shells worse than 256 -- because near the turning point a thin radial shell spans a long path its midpoint density does not represent.

NuFast-LBL.skipped: constant-density baselines only; it has no Earth model and no zenith axis

Prob3++.note: Radial by interface: it reads a table of (outer radius, density, Ye), so the path-length subdivision that fixed GLoBES cannot be handed to it.  Its residual non-monotonicity is that representation, not a choice of this harness.
